verdict.rationale: Granola documents a transcript auto-deletion setting with selectable retention periods (1 day to 1 year), and separately lets users permanently delete or restore meeting notes. Together these give users direct control over both retention and deletion. Missing for 10: automated retention covers only transcripts, not notes; no documented programmatic or API-driven deletion for an AI-native workflow; no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Granola allows you to automatically delete transcripts after a set period of time.
Choose a retention period from the dropdown: 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, or 1 year
This applies only to transcripts — your notes are not affected and will remain available.
Permanently remove notes or recover accidentally deleted ones.
